title: 💃 The Costume Dance Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella are getting dressed for the costume dance recital -- each one has a favorite dance style AND a favorite costume color. Can you figure out who's wearing what?
clues: Luna's dance is not Ballet, Tap, or Hip-Hop.
Bella's costume is not Red or Blue.
Whoever's costume is Yellow loves Hip-Hop.
Whoever's costume is Green loves Tap.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three dances for Luna all at once -- whatever's left over is her answer. Start there.
Clue 7 tells you Luna's costume color directly: Blue. Mark that one with confidence!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name a cat -- they link a costume color straight to a dance. Once you know a cat's dance, check whether it matches either of those clues.
Clue 3 narrows Bella down to just two costume colors left. Try combining it with clue 5 (Green -> Tap) to see which one fits Bella.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clue 1 and the leftovers sort out Whiskers and Oliver -- use clue 6 last to confirm Oliver's costume color.
